scope.correlation_and_vif: not measured for uncomputed ideas; existing idea orthogonality remains in reports/ideas-orthogonality.json

idea_dispositions.reason: The aligned provided-data feature cache exposes per-tract POI totals and source shares, not per-place primary-category histograms. Singleton counts f1 and f2, required for Good-Turing/Chao1, cannot be recovered from those aggregates. The harness has no approved per-place category input/cache contract; emitting zero or an aggregate-derived proxy would fabricate histogram shape.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A rule-clean, region-aligned per-place primary-category input and a declared harness reader, plus a preregistered county-shrinkage rule.

idea_dispositions.reason: The cached tract summaries expose marginal source shares, not per-place multi-source membership or source-list intersections. Capture-recapture needs overlap counts; marginals cannot identify them. The harness therefore cannot fit Chapman or a multi-list model from the current caches without inventing overlap.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A provided per-place dataset-membership input with validated source semantics and preregistered pooling/model rules; exclude Foursquare as the spec directs.

idea_dispositions.reason: The aligned provided-data cache contains tract building counts and source-share aggregates, not individual footprint areas. The reference-layer alternative named in the idea (Microsoft buildings) is forbidden on study tracts. A left-tail deficit cannot be estimated from counts or by substituting a prohibited layer.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A provided-dataset per-footprint area input with declared provenance and a preregistered peer-fit/expected-count rule; do not use Microsoft reference buildings.

idea_dispositions.reason: The idea is a meta-estimator over per-tract component expectation/gap outputs. Current registered outputs are only Tm1, Mx4 and Sc5; the complete component-specific expectation vector and RUCA conditioning contract required to distinguish incompleteness from urbanity are not registered. Fitting a mixture to the available three heterogeneous outputs would silently change the preregistered recipe.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: Prerequisite idea-family outputs for all intended components, a frozen feature/conditioning set, and a deterministic mixture-identifiability/label-orientation rule.

idea_dispositions.reason: The rules' published aggregates are permissible inputs, but they constrain regional moments rather than supplying a per-tract score. The specified monotone calibration requires base per-tract estimators and a frozen transform/selection rule. The available road estimator Sc5 is not a complete base vector for the published definedness and component-ratio moments. Using an aggregate as a tract label or fitting against leaderboard moments is forbidden.
idea_dispositions.missing_prerequisite: A complete rule-clean per-tract base-estimator vector and preregistered monotone calibration procedure using only organizer-published aggregates.

orthogonality.interpretation: No Dst correlation or VIF is claimed because no Dst estimator was computed. The existing report covers the currently implemented estimators; refresh it when a Dst implementation is admitted.
